parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment only mentions the introduction in passing as context ('The paper introduces explainable AI in the introduction'), while the actual issues raised — the missing definition of interpretability, the missing distinction between explainable AI and interpretable methods, and the missing discussion of related work — are paper-level concerns that are not clearly located in or specific to the introduction. Thus, the authors cannot confidently determine which part of the paper the comment addresses. At the same time, the comment clearly specifies what needs to be addressed: defining interpretability, explaining the difference between explainable AI and interpretable methods, and providing the relevant work in this line. This level of grounding with clear specification of the issues is consistent with the rubric's middle category, where the addressed part cannot be confidently determined but the required fixes are clearly specified.
